level: Cultivation Technician I / entry occupational pathway
intendedAudience: Learners progressing through the THC Cultivation Technician I pathway
Entry-level cultivation employees developing supervised operational competency
evidencePolicy: Use canonical evidence-backed science and operational references for durable principles. Facility SOPs, product labels, equipment manuals, and jurisdiction-specific requirements control when they are more specific. Reused curriculum modules are development dependencies and do not substitute for course-specific occupational review.
assessmentPolicy: This draft course is not credential evidence merely because its structure exists. Course-specific formative work, a course-level summative assessment, accessibility review, human technical review, and any required practical evidence must be completed and validated before the course can advance beyond draft/review status.
title: Propagation, Canopy, IPM Scouting & Crop Care
description: Integrates Technician I propagation, transplant, routine canopy work, scouting, sanitation, plant identity, and escalation into controlled work-order execution without granting independent treatment-selection or pesticide-applicator authority.
learningOutcomes: Verify donor, lot, tray, plant, room, and work-order identity before propagation, transplant, scouting, or canopy work.
Execute authorized propagation, transplant, pruning, defoliation, trellis/support, spacing, or similar routine work to the supplied standard.
Follow a repeatable scouting pattern and document location, visible evidence, incidence/severity observations, and uncertainty without unsupported diagnosis.
Maintain sanitation and quarantine boundaries and escalate plant-health or contamination conditions beyond Technician I authority.
